item.title: UK competition regulator investigates Microsoft
item.content:encoded: Last week the UK Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) launched its strategic market status investigation into Microsoft’s business software ecosystem. An investigation doesn’t necessarily imply that Microsoft has done anything wrong; it will examine Microsoft’s position in the markets and decide whether it is powerful enough to require “action to promote customer choice”.
